strategy.summary: Non-nanosecond numpy.datetime64/timedelta64 values passed to Dataset.expand_dims / DataArray.expand_dims (and wrapped in PandasIndexingAdapter inside a Variable) are not cast to nanosecond precision at this buggy commit, because _possibly_convert_datetime_or_timedelta_index does not handle PandasIndexingAdapter. The regression tests assert a 'non-nanosecond precision' UserWarning is raised and the resulting dtype is datetime64[ns]/timedelta64[ns]; on the buggy commit no warning is emitted and the dtype stays [s], so the tests fail.
